test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
Select the correct direct narration of the given sentence.

I stepped forward and asked the store keeper how much the mangoes cost.

options.text: I stepped forward and told to the store keeper, “How much are the mangoes costing?”
I stepped forward and said to the store keeper, “How much do the mangoes cost?”
I stepped forward and said to the store keeper, “How much did the mangoes costed?”
He stepped forward and said to the store keeper, “How much does the mangoes cost?”

solution:
The correct answer is **"I stepped forward and said to the store keeper, “How much do the mangoes cost?”"**
